referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A light productivity product story begins with a soft blue illustrated sky and large centered promise, then places real interface imagery into layered paper-like windows. Small capability glyphs and a portrait strip create early rhythm. The rest alternates lavender, mint, yellow, and white feature panels with concise editorial copy, interface demos, one-line customer quotes, integrations, pricing, a green trial close, and a dense dark footer. The design uses product UI as its main imagery rather than a generic lifestyle hero.

heroGeometry.mode: centered product promise over a hand-drawn sky, with overlapping workspace windows at the lower edge
heroGeometry.alignment: compact top utility navigation, centered short headline, clear trial action, product UI anchoring the composition
heroGeometry.viewport: brand, product category, promise, trial path, and first product interface are visible without an unnecessary copy wall

navigationGeometry.mode: compact horizontal product navigation with account and trial actions
navigationGeometry.placement: small floating capsule aligned near the top of the illustrated hero
navigationGeometry.mobile: compress secondary links into a touch-safe menu while preserving product identity and the trial action

typography.scale: serif display used sparingly for promise and feature chapter; small interface labels remain crisp and sans-serif

palette.contrastIntent: pastel chapter colors support illustration but all body copy and controls retain strong readable contrast

imageTreatment.mode: hand-drawn atmospheric illustration interleaved with crisp authentic product-interface compositions
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero artwork followed by centered floating UI windows and broad feature panels
imageTreatment.focalPoint: the interface state that demonstrates one product capability

servicePresentation.pattern: product capabilities as distinct jobs-to-be-done, demonstrated with real interface scenes instead of uniform service cards
servicePresentation.interaction: small icon index and optional horizontal app rail; keep every feature understandable without hover

ctaPlacement.primary: Start a free trial in the hero and closing green panel
ctaPlacement.secondary: Explore the product or feature demos
ctaPlacement.early: inside the opening view after the product promise

motion.primitive: gentle depth shifts between illustrated clouds and floating UI panels
motion.library: native transforms and low-amplitude scroll reveals
motion.reducedMotion: show all UI panels in their settled positions and preserve the complete reading order

mobileRecomposition.strategy: single-column product narrative with contained horizontal product rails
rules: keep the hero promise and trial control in the first screen
stack interface windows rather than shrinking them
use swipe-safe rails only for genuinely browseable products
retain each chapter's pastel identity without losing readable contrast
keep the footer useful at narrow widths

prohibitedPatterns: copying Craft names, copy, interface, logos, photos, pricing, or product claims
decorative interface screenshots that do not explain a verified capability
using source portraits as client customers or staff

requiredSignatureElements.description: quiet illustrated horizon above a compact workspace preview
feature chapters use distinct but coordinated surface colors and product evidence
a visually distinct final trial invitation before the footer

acceptanceChecks: the hero states a verified product promise and primary action
each capability chapter explains one real customer job
interface imagery is client-provided or newly generated, never copied from the reference
mobile keeps product UI legible and page width at the viewport
trial links, integrations, and plan details are verified before publishing
no source proof, review, price, or claim is transplanted
